summary: V26.k — 4 bug fixes verified on Dal Pastro CRM (390x844 mobile viewport). Backend 4/4 pytest passed (test_v26k_bugfixes.py). Frontend E2E all 4 flows verified. (1) Home callback row body press → /contact/{contact_id} (verified: callback-cb_1ec7f60bf82e → /contact/c_bb497c8ba082). Tapping right-side callback-toggle-{id} only toggles done, stays on /home, DOES NOT open outcome sheet (asserted no [data-testid^=call-outcome-] visible). (2) GET /api/settings returns call_outcomes[0]={id:call_appointment, name:'Presa Appuntamento', color:#16A34A, icon:calendar}; migration applied for existing tenant. Frontend: contact detail → comm-call → call-skip-btn → outcomes rendered in order [call_appointment, call_busy, call_recall, call_no_answer, call_wrong_number, call_not_interested] — FIRST card labelled 'Presa Appuntamento'. (3) My Thing Immagini tab: POST /my-thing (200) with title='TESTIMG_1' → card visible with Modifica + Elimina. Tap Modifica → editor opens with mt-title-input prefilled → change to 'TESTIMG_1_MOD' → tap mt-save-btn → PUT /my-thing/{id} (200) → modal closes, GET /my-thing?kind=image (200) refresh → card now shows 'TESTIMG_1_MOD'. Tap Elimina → window.confirm auto-accepted via page.on('dialog') → DELETE /my-thing/{id} (200) → GET /my-thing?kind=image (200) refresh → item removed. (4) home-my-thing-btn Pressable contains ONLY <Image> when myThingImg truthy; no <Text>, no <svg>, no chevron/sparkles Ionicon (verified via DOM: innerText='', svgs=0, imgs=1). Height=120px, width=358px (fills content area with margin). No overlay text/arrow. Cleanup: 1 leftover TEST_V26K_IMG_1 item (from initial pytest run that failed on response-shape assertion before DELETE finally block) was removed manually. No react-native or expo deprecated-package issues detected in the touched files.
